component.name: Disk Snapshots Manager
component.summary: Recover AnduinOS and restore deleted Personal Files
恢复 AnduinOS 并找回误删的个人文件

description.p: Disk Snapshots Manager creates immutable Btrfs system snapshots for the AnduinOS system and independent snapshots for Personal Files.
A system rollback validates the selected snapshot, preserves the current system as a permanent fallback, and prepares a verified one-shot GRUB entry. Personal Files are explicitly unchanged.
Independent Home snapshots capture the @home subvolume on a separate schedule. Users can browse earlier versions and recover files or folders without rolling back the operating system.
Nautilus provides File History actions for one selected home item and for a folder background, opening a focused Disk Snapshots Manager window for earlier versions and deleted files.
Automatic schedules can show desktop notifications after successful creation, while retention cleanup is reported as one quiet aggregate notification.
Disk Snapshots Manager 为 AnduinOS 系统和用户目录创建独立的不可变 Btrfs 快照。
系统回滚会验证目标系统快照、将当前系统永久保留为回退，并准备经过验证的一次性 GRUB 启动项；个人文件明确不会改变。
独立的个人文件历史按单独计划为 @home 子卷创建快照。用户无需回滚操作系统，即可浏览早期版本并恢复文件或文件夹。
Nautilus 为个人目录中选中的项目和文件夹空白处提供文件历史入口，并打开聚焦的 Disk Snapshots Manager 窗口以浏览早期版本和误删文件。
自动计划可在成功创建后显示桌面通知，保留策略清理则通过一条低干扰的汇总通知报告。
